I have fixed the issue where the `Panel` title and subtitle were missing the panel background style by changing `stylize_before(partial_border_style)` to `stylize_before(border_style)`. This ensures that both the panel's background style and the border's style are applied to the title and subtitle. I verified the fix with reproduction scripts and by running existing tests.

The issue was that the `Panel` title and subtitle were only being stylized with the `partial_border_style`, which omitted the panel's background style. By changing this to use `border_style` (which is the combination of the panel's background style and the border style), the title and subtitle now correctly inherit the panel's background.

Fixed in `rich/panel.py`:
- Changed `title_text.stylize_before(partial_border_style)` to `title_text.stylize_before(border_style)`.
- Changed `subtitle_text.stylize_before(partial_border_style)` to `subtitle_text.stylize_before(border_style)`.

Verified the fix using reproduction scripts and running `tests/test_panel.py`.
